### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**5** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **226** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 30e0bd160ee2afc1557746df0b6806625f37a408` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `6f464897f4fd1f8d66e441c076b9ca061be45c9e` — the merge of head `8fc74827539ea8075a67076d2f22786467681747` into base `30e0bd160ee2afc1557746df0b6806625f37a408`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 6f464897f4fd1f8d66e441c076b9ca061be45c9e && git checkout 6f464897f4fd1f8d66e441c076b9ca061be45c9e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 30e0bd160ee2afc1557746df0b6806625f37a408 8fc74827539ea8075a67076d2f22786467681747 && git checkout -B drift-repro 30e0bd160ee2afc1557746df0b6806625f37a408 && git merge --no-ff 8fc74827539ea8075a67076d2f22786467681747

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 30e0bd160ee2afc1557746df0b6806625f37a408
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.

Head-sha: `834abfdb7452180d9f566f593d3503652dc901bc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .changeset/31224-summary-filter-key-unknown.md, packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts + packages/lint/src/filter-walk.ts, packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts, packages/lint/src/system-fields.ts, packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts, packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts, packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts, packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts, packages/lint/src/index.ts, packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts, packages/objectql/src/summary-aggregate.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts, packages/objectql/src/filter-comparand-shape.ts, packages/objectql/src/relation-filter-lowering.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-judge-filter.test.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-nested-relation-lowering.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts, examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/expense-report.object.ts, skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md, content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, hotcrm src/sales/objects/account.object.ts

Review of PR #31337 (card #31224, item D) on the narrowing face: the PR body and the committed changeset both carry `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, and `reviewFace` maps a `(narrowing)` arm on any declaration text to this tier; no schema path and no governed path is in the five-file list. Read: the net diff `origin/main...834abfdb` (merge base `11c1326d`, one commit, +145/-1), the card body and every comment (triage 6711648543, claim 6712039823, plan 6712129038, seat rulings 6712144718 and 6714195854, dev reports 6713825906 and 6716296533), the check-runs on this head, and the item-C records 6714019852 / 6714102343 / 6714550986 for shape only. Nothing was built, run or re-run; hotcrm was read through the GitHub contents API at its `main` tree `6961ab13`.

### ① Derived judgments

**What the hunk does, read against the code it calls — right as far as it refuses.** The new block in `validateObjectFieldRefs` (`validate-object-field-refs.ts`, after the `FIELD_NAME_SLOTS` loop) reads `field.summaryOperations`, takes `object` as the child and, when `filter` is present, hands the filter to `walkFilterFieldKeys` (`filter-walk.ts`) and judges every emitted `field` through the rule's shared `judge` with `against: child`, `verbatim: false`. `judge` resolves through `resolveFieldPath` (`object-graph.ts`) over `indexServedObjectGraph`, so the three family skips hold exactly as at the other positions: a child the stack does not define (`object-not-in-stack`), a child with no readable field map (`no-field-map`) and a hop through a registry-injected column (`injected-hop`) are `unknowable` and silent (`isUnjudgeable`), a leaf that is an injected column (`id`, `created_at`, `owner_id`, `organization_id`, as `injectedColumnsFor` plans them per object) resolves `ok`, and a field a sibling package adds through `objectExtensions` is in the served graph (`objectsAsServed`). The walk reads the shapes the position admits: the spec's `FilterConditionSchema` (`filter.zod.ts`, a record intersected with `$and` / `$or` / `$not`) is a plain object, so the array and view-rule branches of the walk are dead here; `$and` / `$or` arms keep their index in the path, `$not` descends, an unrecognised `$` key is skipped, an operator object is a leaf, and a nested object with no `$` key is read as a relation hop. The engine's reading of the same value is `buildSummaryIndex` (`engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts`): a plain object is kept as `SummaryDescriptor.filter`, and `aggregateSummaryValue` (`summary-aggregate.ts`) runs `engine.aggregate(child, { where: { $and: [fkMatch, filter] } })`. So a key the child lacks is refused by lint where the engine would answer a recompute failure, with the same object. The verdict sentence is the family's (`describeFieldPathVerdict`): it names the key, the child object and the nearest child field, the path is `objects[i].fields.F.summaryOperations.filter.KEY` (group arms indexed), served item-relative at the door, and the hint names the cure and the object the key belongs to. No false refusal was found in any shape the engine serves: a child field, a child field with operators, a system column, an extension-added field, a key inside a group, and the nested one-level relation form all pass.

**Doors.** `validateObjectFieldRefs` is the one member of the reference-integrity suite that judges an `object` write (`authoring-rules.ts`, the #15254 paragraph; `reference-integrity-suite.ts`), so the refusal reaches `os lint` / `os validate` / `os build`, the active save (`protocol-save.ts`, `assertRuntimeAuthoringRules` at :1677 and `runAuthoringGate` at :1749), the per-item and package publish (`protocol-history-and-publish.ts:950`), and a draft keeps the finding in `_diagnostics` (the new `CASES` row in `protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` pins draft saves `valid: false`, publish refuses, package publish rolls back). The differential of the runtime gate (`runtime-gate.ts`) charges a finding located on the written item to the write, so a parent saved with a bad filter is refused and a stored sibling is not. The restore door was not traced separately here; the item-C record read it as a write through the save door, and no file of this diff changes that.

**Census.** Showcase: `expense-report.object.ts` defines both objects; the four filtered roll-ups (`approved_amount` on `status`, `reimbursable_amount` on `billable`, `rejected_count` on `status`, `over_limit_count` on `amount`) name fields `showcase_expense_line` declares at :170 / :173 / :176. The other example roll-ups (`app-crm` opportunity, showcase invoice and project, the CLI lint corpus) carry no filter. hotcrm `main`: 21 `*.object.ts` files, one with `summaryOperations` (`src/sales/objects/account.object.ts`, a sum over `crm_account.annual_revenue` with `relationshipField`, no filter). Docs: `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` and `protocol/objectql/types.mdx` show `filter: { type: 'signup' }` on an `engagement` child, a child field. Nothing shipped is refused.

**MUST-FIX: the tree pins and documents, as accepted, a relationship spelling the engine refuses at every recompute.** The new test "passes child fields, operators, and a relationship path through the child" asserts `validateObjectFieldRefs` is silent on `filter: { 'account.status': 'active' }`; the changeset's Now bullet says "a relationship path is resolved through the child"; the module header says "nested relationship hops"; the `os explain` paragraph says "or a relationship path". Read against the engine: `assertFilterIsMaterializable` (`filter-comparand-shape.ts:442-510`) runs on the `where` of every verb including `aggregate` (`engine-top-level.ts:884`; `engine-judge-filter.test.ts` pins `{ 'account.name': 'Acme' }` refused `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 on `aggregate`), its collector `collectFilterFieldNames` (:582-603) descends `$and` / `$or` / `$not` so the `{ $and: [fkMatch, filter] }` that `aggregateSummaryValue` builds is walked, and a dotted key whose head is a relation field is refused with the words "No backend serves the path" and the prescription to nest the condition beneath the relation field. Since #20802 the engine serves the nested one-level form `{ account: { status: 'active' } }` at `where` (`relation-filter-lowering.ts`, "Where. `where`, on every verb that takes one (find, findOne, count, aggregate, ...)") and still refuses the dotted spelling and any second level. The recompute catches the throw and records it (`engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts:471-481`), which the call sites surface as `SummaryRecomputeError` while the child row stays written and the summary stays stale: the card's defect, byte for byte, for a stack this PR passes at every door and now pins as a supported shape. `walkFilterFieldKeys` cannot tell the two spellings apart (`conditionFieldKeys` flattens the nested form to the same `field` and the same `path` as the dotted key), so the position needs a read of the authored keys of its own: refuse a dotted key (the engine's own `dotted` arm: `key.includes('.')`, descending the three combinators) with the engine's cure, keep the nested one-level form accepted, move the pin to the nested form, and reword the changeset bullet, the header and the explanation so a release-owned text does not teach the refused spelling. The direction of the narrowing is not in question, this is a false accept declared as a capability in the diff, not a false refusal.

**Should-fix: a `formula` child field as a filter key.** Lint resolves it as a declared field and stays silent; the engine refuses it on every verb (`filter-comparand-shape.ts:515-550`, `isVirtualSearchField`, `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES = { formula }` in `search-fields.ts`; `summary` and `autonumber` are stored and are fine), with the same stale-summary outcome. The leaf verdict carries `meta.type`, so the position can refuse `formula` leaves with the engine's denormalise cure. Same for a second relation level (`{ account: { owner: { name } } }`), which lint resolves as two hops and the engine refuses ("Forward, one level"). Both can land in the same parity pass as the must-fix.

**Should-fix (minor): the block fires on a `summaryOperations` carried by a field whose `type` is not `summary`.** `buildSummaryIndex` reads only `type === 'summary'` and `lintSummaryRollups` (`data-model-rules.ts`) guards on it; this block does not. It refuses dead metadata with a true sentence, so no capability is lost; guard on the type for consistency with the two readers.

**Observations, not findings.** A dotted path into a `json` child field is refused `hop-not-relationship` here as at every path-resolving position of the family; the SQL driver refuses it too, the memory and mongodb carve-out in `classifyDottedFilterHead` is the engine's deliberate pass-through and is not new to this position. A filter object spelled `{ field, operator }` is read by the shared walk as a view rule; `validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts` already reads this position through the same walk, so the reading is the platform's, not this PR's.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset `@objectstack/lint: minor` — right.** AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3: a `Metadata-protocol` kind other than `none` takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves. `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` level axis: `narrowed` must grade at least one moved package `minor` and must sit beside a `(narrowing)` arm; both hold, and `Check Changeset` concluded success on this head. BREAKING banner present; the single ADR-0087 marker reads `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` with its reason (no key added, removed or renamed; a refused key never filtered what the author meant, so there is no meaning-preserving rewrite), the disposition item C landed with; the body's "What an author does" names a fix of the metadata, not a consumer-code rewrite, the same shape `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` admitted on `31224-flow-node-unreachable.md`. `Lint & Repo Gates`, which carries that gate, concluded success.
- **`Metadata-protocol: narrowed` — right.** A summary field an author could write is now refused at the object save and publish doors: "a value refused or a requirement tightened is `narrowed`" (step 3), as seat ruling 6714195854 states.
- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — right, and the item-C reasoning is consistent with it, not against it.** `clause2-line.mjs` reads the value as the answer to whether the card widens an accept set or the public surface. Item C answered `yes` because it added `FLOW_NODE_UNREACHABLE` to `packages/lint/src/index.ts` and a new `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` key for a new rule id. This diff touches neither: `index.ts` is not in the file list, `OBJECT_FIELD_REF_UNKNOWN` is the existing export (`index.ts:614`), and `rule-explanations.ts` gains one paragraph inside the existing `OBJECT_FIELD_REF_UNKNOWN_EXPLANATION.paragraphs` array, whose key `object-field-ref-unknown` already sits in `RULE_EXPLANATIONS` on `main` (:5931). A paragraph of an existing entry is prose, not a key; no export, no rule id, no explanations key is added, so `no` is the truthful value and `(narrowing)` the arm. Body and changeset agree. The must-fix above changes none of this: the parity fix adds no export either.
- **`Skills-docs: none — ...` — present in both, byte-equal, and the reason checks out.** The pm-dispatch template (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:313`) owes the body a third line for a `(narrowing)` arm; the body carries it line-initial. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:132` names `filter?` without an example; the `content/docs` examples filter on a child field. Once the must-fix lands, the "relationship path" wording in the changeset and explanation is the only text that needs to move, and it is this PR's own.
- **The `!` in `fix(lint)!:`** — no mechanical effect, consistent with the BREAKING banner, as judged for item C.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **MUST-FIX — the dotted relationship spelling pinned as accepted** (① above). A FAIL on its own.
- **Dev `open_questions`: none** (6716296533). The dev's declaration deviation from the claim is the seat's own ruling (6714195854), followed exactly.
- **Dev flags carried, none blocking:** the "measured consequence" probe and the "reverse check" were one-off and are not in the tree; the census numbers were re-derived above from the tree and from hotcrm and agree (4 / 0 / 0 unknown keys; 9 unfiltered example roll-ups). The dev's gate report says 66 derived gates exit 0 and `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0 with the body; not re-run here, CI is the confirmation.
- **Check-runs on `834abfdb` at this read:** success — `Lint & Repo Gates` (required) and every `Lint ·` lane, `Build Core` (required), `Dogfood Regression Gate` (required), `Governed Surface Queue Guard` (required), `Live E2E UI` (required), `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Build UI Deps`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `Plan Test Core shards`, `PR-body guards`, `Auto Label`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `filter`; **still in progress, every one a required context or a lane of one** — `TypeScript Type Check` (lanes `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · consumer gates`), `Test Core (1–8/8)`, `Test UI (1–16/16)`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`; skipped (opt-in or path-filtered) — `Lint UI`, `Build Docs`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, `UI Published Artifacts`, `Temporal Conformance`, `Packed-tarball smoke`, `18.x upgrade harness`, the schedule gate. No red on this head at this read. The verdict below does not wait on the in-progress ones: it is decided by the contract finding in ①.
- **Tier of this record:** served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on the narrowing face, the tier `reviewFace` (`scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`) owes for a `(narrowing)` arm on any declaration text; `hits` is empty on this file list, so the Scope floor is every path of the diff.
- **PR body (data, not judged):** its gate, dogfood and suite readings are the dev's on `834abfdb`; the body's claim "a relationship path is resolved through the child" is the sentence ① refutes for the dotted spelling.

### ④ Design judgment

Against the published spec on `main`: `FieldSchema.summaryOperations.filter` (`field.zod.ts`) admits any `FilterConditionSchema` and describes it as "a query `where` FilterCondition" over the child; the narrowing refuses, at lint, a key that condition could never run against the child it names, and takes no declared capability away at any consumer: every key the engine's `where` serves on the child (a declared or extension-added field, an injected column, an operator object, a group, the nested one-level relation form) still passes, and a child the stack does not define stays unjudged, the same install-order reasoning `lintSummaryRollups` records. Lint is the right altitude: the verdict needs the child's field map, which one field's Zod parse cannot see, and the rule already sits on every door an object write takes. The parity with the runtime is right in the refusing direction and wrong in the accepting one: the diff declares the dotted relationship spelling supported at this position while the engine refuses it at the one call that reads it (`aggregate`'s `where`, through `assertFilterIsMaterializable`), which is the exact silent-stale-summary shape the card enforces against, written into a pinned test, the module header, the `os explain` entry and a release-owned changeset. That is the must-fix; the `formula`-leaf and second-level cases are the should-fixes beside it. With those closed the design holds: the narrowing makes the spec's own description of the key real, `packages/spec` is untouched, and `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is the right ADR-0087 disposition.

Delta review of PR #31337 (card #31224, item D) on the narrowing face, following the FAIL record 6716423527 on `834abfdb`. The new head is one commit on top of it (`8fc74827`, "read a roll-up filter's keys as authored, the way the recompute query serves them"); the merge base with `origin/main` is still `11c1326d`, the net diff is the same five files (+382/-1), and `packages/spec`, `packages/objectql` and `packages/lint/src/index.ts` are byte-identical to the merge base. Findings of 6716423527 that this delta does not touch — the child-object binding, the three family skips, the doors (lint / validate / build, active save, publish, drafts kept in `_diagnostics`), the census (showcase 4 filtered roll-ups on child fields, hotcrm 0) — stand as written there and are not repeated.

### ① Derived judgments

**The must-fix landed — right.** The position no longer imports `filter-walk.ts` (`validate-object-field-refs.ts` imports `classifyDottedFilterHead` and `isVirtualSearchField` from `@objectstack/spec/data` instead; no `walkFilterFieldKeys` reference remains in the file). `judgeSummaryFilter` reads the authored keys itself: `$and` / `$or` arms (indexed) and a `$not` body are descended, any other `$` key is an operator and ends the descent, and each remaining key is judged by its own spelling. The dotted spelling `account.status` is now refused with the hint `Nest the condition beneath the relation field: { account: { status: VALUE } }.` (pinned), and the accepted pin moved to the nested one-level form `account: { status: 'active', industry: { $in: ['saas'] } }` — the form the engine serves at `where` on every verb including `aggregate` (`relation-filter-lowering.ts`, #20802). The changeset Now bullets, the module header and the `os explain` paragraph no longer say a relationship path is resolved; each names the dotted spelling as refused with the nested cure. Verified by reading the three texts at this head.

**Both should-fixes landed — right.** A `formula` key is refused through `isVirtualSearchField` (`SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES = { formula }`, `search-fields.ts`), at the top level and one level down, with the denormalise cure (pinned on `is_big` and `account.score_band`). The block is guarded on `meta?.type === 'summary'` (`meta` is the owner's graph slice for the field), matching `buildSummaryIndex` and `lintSummaryRollups`; pinned by "judges only a `summary` field".

**Parity with the engine, verdict by verdict.** The engine's reading of the recompute `where` (`{ $and: [fkMatch, filter] }`, `summary-aggregate.ts`) is two doors: `assertFilterIsMaterializable` (`filter-comparand-shape.ts`, run for `aggregate` at `engine-top-level.ts:884`, its collector descending `$and` / `$or` / `$not`) and, for a no-operator object beneath a relation column, `admitRelationCondition` (`relation-filter-lowering.ts`, handed the condition by the `where` walk in `number-comparand-declared-type-door.ts`, `servesRelations: true`).
- Dotted key, relation head: engine `INVALID_FIELD` with the nested route; lint refuses with the nested route. Match.
- Dotted key, virtual or scalar head: engine `INVALID_FIELD` with the denormalise remedy; lint `classifyDottedFilterHead` is not `null` and not `relation`, refused with the denormalise cure. Match. The classification is the engine's own function (`filter-dotted-head.ts`), so `relation` is exactly `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` (`lookup`, `master_detail`, `user`, `tree`, single or `multiple`), and a `lookup` and a `master_detail` head read alike.
- Dotted key, head the classifier leaves `null` (structured JSON, `multiple`, file, unreadable type): engine passes it through; lint `continue`s. Match (silent both sides).
